name: Microns — Dental Booking & Triage Agent (Sarah)
firstMessage: Thanks for calling {{PRACTICE_NAME}}! This is Sarah. How can I help you today?
endCallMessage: Thanks so much for calling. Take care!

messages.content: PASTE THE CONTENTS OF system-prompts/booking-agent.txt HERE, or reference it via the VAPI dashboard's prompt editor. Keep {{PRACTICE_NAME}} as a template variable — the backend supplies it in assistantOverrides.variableValues on every call.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Look up open appointment slots. Always call this before offering any time to a caller.

days_ahead.description: How many days out to search. Default 7.

limit.description: How many slots to return. Keep to 3 for a phone call.

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book a slot the caller has chosen. Confirm their full name and phone number first.

slot_start.description: ISO-8601 UTC start time, taken from check_availability. Never invent one.

patient_name.description: Full name as the caller gave it

patient_phone.description: Callback number in E.164 where possible, e.g. +15551234567

function.name: lookup_appointment
function.description: Find the caller's upcoming appointments by phone number.

patient_phone.description: Defaults to the caller ID if omitted

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Move an existing appointment to a new time from check_availability.

appointment_id.description: From lookup_appointment. Omit to use the caller's next appointment.

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancel an appointment. Offer to rebook before ending the call.

appointment_id.description: Omit to use the caller's next appointment

function.name: get_pricing
function.description: Fetch the price range for a treatment. Quote only from this.

function.name: answer_faq
function.description: Answer a non-clinical logistical question — hours, parking, what a visit involves, general aftercare, insurance basics. Follows system-prompts/insurance-faq-agent.txt. Automatically escalates instead of answering if the question turns out to be a real emergency or a clinical judgment call.

function.name: request_emergency_escalation
function.description: A real dental emergency: knocked-out or badly broken tooth, uncontrolled bleeding, facial trauma or swelling, severe uncontrolled pain. Alerts the on-call dentist immediately (within 15 minutes) — follows system-prompts/emergency-triage-agent.txt. Use this instead of request_callback whenever the situation matches that prompt's escalation criteria.

reason.description: Short description of the emergency, e.g. 'knocked-out front tooth from a fall'

callback_number.description: Preferred callback number. Ask for it; default to caller ID.

function.name: request_callback
function.description: A clinical question that is NOT an emergency — a treatment-safety judgment call, a medication interaction, anything the dentist should weigh in on. Promises a callback within 2 hours.

callback_number.description: Preferred callback number. Ask for it; default to caller ID.

messages.content: Summarise the call in two sentences for practice staff. Record what was booked, changed or asked. Do not include clinical detail the caller volunteered.

_setup_notes.1_server_url: Point serverUrl at https://YOUR-DOMAIN/webhooks/vapi — one URL handles every event type. If you prefer split routes, use /voice/inbound, /voice/action and /voice/end instead.
_setup_notes.2_secret: serverUrlSecret must equal VAPI_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env. VAPI sends it as the X-Vapi-Secret header and the backend rejects requests without it.
_setup_notes.3_prompt: The full system prompt lives in system-prompts/booking-agent.txt (it embeds the emergency-triage escalation rule and points to answer_faq for logistics). Paste it into model.messages[0].content, or manage it in the VAPI dashboard.
_setup_notes.4_variables: The backend returns assistantOverrides.variableValues (PRACTICE_NAME, PATIENT_FIRST_NAME, IS_RETURNING_PATIENT, BOOKING_URL, AFTER_HOURS) from the assistant-request event, so a returning patient is greeted by name.
_setup_notes.5_local_testing: Expose the backend with `ngrok http 8000` and set serverUrl to the ngrok URL while testing.
_setup_notes.6_hipaa: Sign a BAA with VAPI and with your transcription and voice vendors before taking real calls. Transcripts are PHI: this backend encrypts them at rest, but they also exist in each vendor's dashboard until you configure retention there.
